name: al-spec
description: ALSpec independent DR, Story, and TestCase SKILLs, each with embedded writing rules and a mandatory template context, plus global type rules and project template mappings.

interface.longDescription: ALSpec currently defines three independent specification types: DR, Story, and TestCase. Each type SKILL is its own writing specification and requires one canonical template selected by project mapping or global fallback. Project templates add exact output structure and vocabulary. PRD and CodingPlan are reserved for a later scope expansion.
capabilities: Embedded writing rules with mandatory template loading
defaultPrompt: Use the matching al-spec type SKILL to create a DR, Story, or TestCase; load its mandatory template context.
Use the matching al-spec type SKILL to review a specification for completeness and evidence.
When the repository has a confirmed project ID, select the exact project template mapping for the type; DR, Story, and TestCase use their global type SKILL with the mapped project template.
